issue.title: Support cleanup of deleted classes during live reload

labels.name: triage/waiting-for-ci
labels.description: Ready to merge when CI successfully finishes

body:
Hi, we are using Rocker as a compile time replacement for some old JSPs, with this issue all generated Rocker classes are deleted during development.

As a quick fix we copy/pasted them, does exist a switch to disable this feature until is fixed ?

An additional workaround is to launch “mvn compile quarkus:dev” instead of “quarkus:dev” only, after configuring pom.xml with build helper plugin:

```
<plugin>
    <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
    <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
    <version>3.0.0</version>
    <executions>
        <execution>
            <phase>generate-sources</phase>
            <goals>
                <goal>add-source</goal>
            </goals>
            <configuration>
                <sources>
                    <source>${project.build.directory}/rocker</source>
                </sources>
            </configuration>
        </execution>
    </executions>
</plugin>
```
@machi1990 could you take a look? It looks related to the work you did on removing classes?

issue.title: Do not delete generated files
issue.body:
Fixes #3448 - generated files that are not within module source paths returned a null sourceFilePath. We should not delete the corresponding generated .class file in this case.

/cc @antoniomacri @masini this should fix the issue you encountered. 

/cc @gsmet

body: @antoniomacri @masini thanks for reporting and I was able to reproduce the bug thanks to your reproducer. We have a fix in place in #3613 (could you confirm ? :-) ), but till that is merged launching the dev mode command as @vivynz suggested `mvn compile quarkus:dev` is a good workaround.
